ambiguity.detail: The specific identity of the arsonist is unknown.

verdict.hook_line: Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: After narrowly escaping an explosion and watching their home burn down, the survivors search for answers.
verdict.why_it_works: The explosive window crash hook instantly pulls scrollers in, followed by deeply emotional post-disaster grief.
